model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) for several methods. The x-axis represents "Co-occurrence Number" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 3 to over 3,000, with tick marks at 10⁰·⁷ (approximately 5), 10¹, 10², 10³, and beyond. The y-axis represents "ACC (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 35% to 65%, with tick marks at intervals of 5 percentage points. Six lines are shown, each corresponding to a different method. The "Base" line (black, solid, with circle markers) starts at approximately 37% at the lowest co-occurrence number, rises gradually to about 43.5% around co-occurrence number 100, and then remains relatively flat at approximately 43.5% at the highest co-occurrence values. The "FT" line (light blue, solid, with downward-triangle markers) begins at approximately 39.5%, increases steadily, and reaches about 47.5% at the highest co-occurrence number. The "IKE" line (red, solid, with upward-triangle markers) starts at approximately 43%, rises to about 44.5% at co-occurrence number 30, continues increasing to around 46% at 300, and reaches approximately 49% at the highest value. The "MEND" line (brown, solid, with diamond markers) begins at approximately 44.5%, increases to about 48.5% at co-occurrence number 30, rises further to around 54% at 300, and reaches approximately 56.5% at the highest co-occurrence number. The purple line (with pentagon markers, partially obscured label) starts at approximately 43.5%, increases to about 51% at co-occurrence number 30, rises to around 53% at 300, and reaches approximately 54.5% at the highest value. The "ROME" line (green, solid, with square markers) starts at approximately 51% at the lowest co-occurrence number, increases to about 57% at co-occurrence number 30, continues rising to approximately 62% at 300, and reaches the highest value of approximately 65.5% at the largest co-occurrence number.
